WITH site_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sp.memusagegb) as site_avg_ram,
    AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS FLOAT) / sp.proccpu) as site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8
    AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL 
    AND sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL 
    AND sp.proccpu > 0
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat
)
SELECT 
  entrystat,
  AVG(site_avg_ram) as avg_of_site_avg_ram,
  AVG(site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) as avg_of_site_avg_ratio
FROM site_stats
GROUP BY entrystat
ORDER BY entrystat
